TransientSparse.why: These two sparse fields live on LinksTables itself rather than inside SymbolLinksCold.

fieldPlacements.LiteralData: Literal tail value_kind (0 string, 1 number, 2 bigint), value_low/high; two f64 words preserve bits.
fieldPlacements.InferenceInfo.priority: Raw i32 bits in priority; flags bit 2 records presence, preserving None, Some(0), and Some(CIRCULARITY=-1).
fieldPlacements.InferenceInfo.implied_arity: Checked usize->u32 domain; flags bit 3 records presence, including Some(u32::MAX).
